{{Quote|As an organization, the Meatlumps are growing in numbers daily.''"<br />"''I've noticed, there are a lot of people running around these sewers.''"<br />"''There could be more. You think you could give me a hand?|Recruiter Joe and a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MR" />}}
'''Joe''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Meatlumps|Meatlump]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he operated out of the [[Meatlump Hideout]] in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. As a recruiter for the technolohy-hating Meatlumps, it was [[Gender/Legends|his]] job to seek out new members for the gang.<ref name="SWG:MR" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Recruiter Joe tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with traveling [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and handing out [[Book/Legends|books]] called the ''[[Meatlump Manifesto]]'' in order to attract new recruits.<ref name="SWG:MR" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateMeatlumpHideoutMale.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Recruiter Joe]]
Recruiter Joe was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Recruiter Joe was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Meatlumps Theme Park|Meatlumps Theme Park]]," introduced with "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>

During each server reset, Joe's appearance was randomized, but he consistently appeared as a Human male.<ref name="SWG:MR" />
